items.source: Creates new AggregationExpression that takes array of the previously mentioned field and one or more arrays and returns an array that contains the elements that appear in every of those.
items.translation: 创建一个新的AggregationExpression，该表达式接收一个前述字段和多个数组作为参数，并返回一个包含所有这些数组共同元素的数组。

items.source: Creates new AggregationExpression that compares the previously mentioned field to one or more arrays and returns true if they have the same distinct elements and false otherwise.
items.translation: 创建一个新的AggregationExpression，用于将前述字段与一个或多个数组进行比较，如果它们具有相同的唯一元素则返回 true，否则返回 false。

items.source: Creates new AggregationExpression that takes array of the previously mentioned field and one or more arrays and returns an array that contains the elements that appear in any of those.
items.translation: 创建一个新的AggregationExpression，该表达式接收前文所述字段的数组以及一个或多个其他数组，并返回包含这些数组中任意元素的新数组。

items.source: expression - must not be null.
items.translation: expression 不能为 null。

items.source: arrayReferences - must not be null.
items.translation: arrayReferences - 不能为 null。

items.source: expressions - must not be null.
items.translation: expressions - 不得为 null。

items.source: Creates new SetOperators.SetOperatorFactory for given AggregationExpression.
items.translation: 为给定的AggregationExpression创建新的SetOperators.SetOperatorFactory。

items.source: Creates new AggregationExpression that takes array of the previously mentioned field and returns an array containing the elements that do not exist in the given AggregationExpression.
items.translation: 创建一个新的AggregationExpression，该表达式接收前述字段的数组作为输入，并返回一个不包含给定AggregationExpression中元素的数组。

items.source: Creates new AggregationExpression that takes array of the previously mentioned field and returns true if it is a subset of the given AggregationExpression.
items.translation: 创建一个新的AggregationExpression，该表达式接收前述字段的数组作为参数，并返回一个布尔值，表示该数组是否为给定AggregationExpression的子集。

items.source: Creates new SetOperators.SetOperatorFactory for given fieldReference.
items.translation: 为给定的 fieldReference 创建新的SetOperators.SetOperatorFactory。

items.source: Creates new AggregationExpression that tkes array of the previously mentioned field and returns true if no elements is false.
items.translation: 创建一个新的AggregationExpression，该表达式接收前述字段的数组作为参数，并在没有元素为 false 时返回 true。

items.source: Creates new AggregationExpression that takes array of the previously mentioned field and returns true if any of the elements are true and false otherwise.
items.translation: 创建一个新的AggregationExpression，该表达式接收前述字段的数组作为参数，并在其中任意元素为 true 时返回 true，否则返回 false。

items.source: Creates new AggregationExpression that takes array of the previously mentioned field and returns an array containing the elements that do not exist in the given arrayReference.
items.translation: 创建一个新的AggregationExpression，该表达式接收之前提到的字段的数组作为参数，并返回一个不包含给定数组引用中元素的数组。

items.source: Creates new AggregationExpression that takes array of the previously mentioned field and returns true if it is a subset of the given arrayReference.
items.translation: 创建一个新的AggregationExpression，该表达式接收前述字段的数组作为参数，并返回一个布尔值，表示该字段数组是否为给定 arrayReference 的子集。
